'''Bruan''', known also as '''The Durasteel Fist''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. During the War, he was stationed in the [[Imperial Intelligence Gadget Warehouse]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] where he was killed by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] aligned individuals.<ref name="TOR" />
